question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word which has been incorrectly spelt.

Mrs. Lal taught me English __gramar__.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (1) i.e. **"grammar".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Incorrectly spelt word is "**gramar**"
 
• The **Correct **spelling is **Grammar **(व्याकरण) - The set of structural rules governing the composition of clauses, phrases, and words in any given natural language.
 
• **Example**: Proper grammar enhances the quality of writing.

Therefore, the correct answer is "grammar".
